import socket
import ssl
import urllib.request
import json

# Try to access Wikipedia API
try:
    ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
    conn = ctx.wrap_socket(socket.socket(), server_name='en.wikipedia.org')
    conn.connect(('en.wikipedia.org', 443))
    req = 'GET /w/api.php?action=query&titles=Franklin%E2%80%93Foxboro_line&prop=extracts&explaintext=1&format=json HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: en.wikipedia.org\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n'
    conn.send(req.encode())
    response = b''
    while True:
        data = conn.recv(4096)
        if not data:
            break
        response += data
    text = response.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
    # Find the extract
    start = text.find('\"extract\":\"')
    if start > 0:
        start += len('\"extract\":\"')
        end = text.find('\"', start)
        extract = text[start:end].replace('\\\\n', '\n').replace('\\\\\"', '\"')
        print(extract[:3000])
    else:
        print('No extract found')
        print(text[:2000])
except Exception as e:
    print(f'Error: {e}')
" 2>&1
